name: Movement
description: Movement helpers: edge jumps, auto walk, keyboard-style tap resolution, and an automatic ender pearl clutch over the void.

addons.Parkour: Presses jump at block edges while you sprint forward. Only presses the jump key.
addons.AutoWalk: Holds forward until you turn it off, or press back.
addons.SnapTap: Last-pressed key wins for W/S and A/D, like SOCD keyboards.
addons.AutoPearlClutch: When you fall into the void, aims and throws an ender pearl onto the nearest safe block.
